title: Hessian Estimates for Convex Solutions of Hessian Quotient Equations via Compactness
summary: We give a compactness proof of interior Hessian estimates for convex solutions of $σ_n(D^2u)/σ_{n-2}(D^2u)=1$ and $σ_n(D^2u)/σ_{n-1}(D^2u)=f(x,u,Du)>0$, with $1/f$ concave in the gradient variable in the latter case, revisiting results of Lu and Fung.
